日焼け止めはどうやって紫外線を止める？――光のエネルギーの行き先を変える薄い膜

A Japanese-English mixed explanation of how sunscreen works as a thin optical filter. Rather than treating organic filters as absorbers and mineral filters as simple reflectors, it follows UV photons through absorption, electronic excitation, relaxation, scattering, photostability, wavelength-selective filtering, SPF/PA, and film formation.
